description: Dopravní informace souvisící s bezpečností silničního provozu (SRTI) formou otevřených propojených dat (LOD) is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ředitelství silnic a dálnic s. p.. Traffic information from the whole Czechia related to road safety according to the EC Regulation ( The data are a subset of the data source ´DATEX II - Common Traffic Information´ from the NDIC CR, transformed into an open data format and made available via SPARQL endpoint as individual traffic information as well as a ... Coverage: Ředitelství silnic a dálnic s. p.. The portal shows the English title as "Safety-related road traffic information (SRTI) as Linked Open Data (LOD)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ředitelství silnic a dálnic s. p.. Its keywords include 886/2013, bezpečnost provozu, traffic information, accidents, nehody, Směrnice ITS. The listing shows 2 download or service links in RDF_TURTLE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/65993390/1087749998/distribuce/00fb1ff96754614aafa24ec5e2f68bea/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
